text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Symboli Rudolf gears herself up for the Satsuki Sho, but it weighs on her mind that the rest of the student council had kept the general manager's doubts a secret from her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As she steps onto the track, she resolves to aim for absolute perfection. If she can always be her best self, nobody will hesitate to rely on her again.
